patch_description: Replace the current ansatz block with a symmetry-aware, line-motif-focused block that merges the best elements seen in prior candidates: (1) explicit three-qubit ZZZ motifs aligned with the eight winning lines so the circuit can directly sense line correlations, (2) a CZ lattice backbone for stable entanglement propagation, (3) shared center-edge parametric control both in Z (CRZ) and X (CRX) to give complementary phase and bit-flip controlled interactions around the important center, and (4) symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (pre/post RZ and RY) to reduce parameter count while retaining expressivity. A doubly-controlled diagonal CCRZ is kept to complement diagonal detection. Parameter-sharing is used deliberately (corner/edge/center groups and shared center-edge controls) to keep parameter efficiency reasonable while increasing expressivity relative to the current block. This balances inductive bias toward Tic-Tac-Toe winning lines with richer control axes (CRX + CRZ) to help the optimizer reach better minima and reduce the train-test gap.
